ques: Find the Ordo Kids Oscillating Brush Heads in the Oral Care collection. From the product's Details, Directions, and Specifications, report the compatible toothbrush, the recommended replacement interval for one head, the maximum normal coverage from the two-head pack, and the listed life stage.

Search for the Crest Pro-Health Clean Mint breath mist. Open the two-pack product and report its size, the weight shown beside its item number, whether the description says it is sugar-free, and its displayed price in this snapshot.

In the Shampoo collection, filter to OGX and compare all three captured products. Identify the one with the most customer reviews, give its review count and price, and list the other two products with their prices. Use the counts shown in this snapshot.

Find the two 12 OZ shampoos whose brand is exactly Dove, excluding Dove Men+Care. Report both full product names and their displayed prices, then state the price difference between them in this snapshot.

Find the TheraBreath Healthy Gums toothpaste and Whitening Fresh Breath mouthwash in Oral Care. Compare their captured package sizes and displayed prices. Calculate each price per ounce, rounded to the nearest cent, and identify which costs less per ounce.

Browse the captured Oral Care collection and use a maximum price of $20. Find the product with the largest displayed customer-review count among those results. Report its full name, brand, flavor, price, and review count.

Use the store locator to compare the three captured Champaign pharmacies. For Monday, September 28, 2026, identify the pharmacy with the latest closing time. Report its store number, full address, phone number, pharmacy hours, and lunch closure.

Find the captured Chicago stores labeled Store open 24 hours. Compare their pharmacy hours for Sunday, October 4, 2026, and select the one whose pharmacy closes later as your store. Report its address and Sunday pharmacy hours, and explain whether the pharmacy itself is open 24 hours.

In the store locator, find the captured Chicago location that lists all three services: Accepts WIC, UPS access point, and Drug disposal. Open its detail page and report its store number, full address, phone number, and pharmacy lunch closure.

Compare the Champaign CVS Pharmacy at Target on North Prospect Avenue with the Schnucks pharmacy on North Mattis Avenue. For Saturday, October 3, 2026, report each pharmacy's opening and closing times, identify which opens earlier and closes later, and give each lunch closure.

Find a captured Savoy store that offers both Photo and UPS access point. Select it as your store, then report its address, store number, and separate store and pharmacy hours for Sunday, October 4, 2026.

Open Shipping Information in Help. Report the standard shipping charge and free-shipping purchase threshold, compare the stated delivery estimates for CVS-fulfilled and vendor-direct orders, and give the stated delay before a tracking number may appear. Preserve the policy's processing-time qualification.

Read Return Policy and compare the rule for most new, unopened nonprescription purchases with the Our CVS Brands guarantee. Report the standard return window, whether the private-brand guarantee covers opened packages and has a time limit, what to bring for an in-store private-brand return, and the phone number to call before a mail return.

Use the Checkout help page to answer these questions: Can someone check out as a guest? What two conditions must an ExtraCare card meet before it can be attached for online rewards? Once an order has been placed, can it be canceled, and what return-initiation step does the page recommend instead?
